description: Trick a CDN/cache into storing a victim's authenticated response at a public URL, then read it. Load on "web cache deception", when a CDN/cache sits in front of an app that serves per-user content, or to test whether private pages can be cached. Signals: `X-Cache`/`CF-Cache-Status` headers, caching by file extension, static-looking suffixes on dynamic endpoints.
